deploy_path: AI emits suggested.patch only. A human reviewer promotes it into a signed update.zip (Phase 4, Ed25519). No direct apply path exists.

bundle_integrity.rationale: SHA-256 manifest check detects (a) accidental corruption, (b) third-party file modification without manifest rewrite, (c) AI hallucinating files not in the bundle. It does NOT detect a user-fabricated self-consistent malicious bundle. Bundle authenticity is the Ed25519 gate's responsibility at the update.zip step (Phase 4), not here. Acceptable under ai_is_deploy_actor=false.

rejects_on: patch_sha256 mismatch against unsigned zip patch.diff
reviewer_gate_script_sha256 mismatch (reviewer script was modified after review)
signer_gate.rationale: Without a valid review_pass.json artifact, the signer cannot produce a signed update.zip. This is the structural closure of the forbidden_paths gate — reviewer enforcement is no longer dependent on operator memory.

class_declaration.rationale: AI declares which auto_apply_allowed (or approval_required) category the patch falls under. The reviewer gate runs class-specific allow-list checks (currently cache_clear must touch only cache_clear_allowlist paths). Other classes inherit the forbidden_paths check only.

auto_apply_preconditions.dist_rebuild: TypeScript/frontend sources unchanged. Deterministic pnpm run build output only. Reviewer reproduces the build before promotion.
auto_apply_preconditions.uv_sync: uv lock --check returns exit 0 against the proposed uv.lock. No git reference allowed. Demote to approval_required if integrity cannot be verified.
auto_apply_preconditions.cache_clear: Touches only paths in cache_clear_allowlist. Any path outside the allowlist forces demotion to approval_required.
auto_apply_preconditions.missing_example_config_seed: Copy from a .example file only. Do not overwrite existing config.
auto_apply_preconditions.log_improvement: Log message strings only. Do not touch i18n keys, log levels, or log targets.
auto_apply_preconditions.null_guard: Single statement of form 'if <expr> is None: return <const>' or 'if <expr> is None: raise <NamedException>(...)'. No new elif/else/for/while/nested branching. No change to existing return values on the non-None path.
auto_apply_preconditions.i18n_key_addition: Only new keys. Must not modify or remove existing keys. Must not affect API response shape.

expected_output.REPAIR_REPORT.md: Machine-verified facts and AI claims visually separated per template
expected_output.suggested.patch: AI-generated patch. Must not be named patch.diff.
expected_output.test_result.txt: Verbatim test runner output only. AI must not edit, summarize, paraphrase, or fabricate. Write single token NO_TESTS_RUN if no test was run.
